decision: Models for Phase 2: Llama 3.3 70B on the A100 (baseline), DeepSeek V3.2 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 through OpenRouter, MedGemma-27B on the A100 if it can be set up; OpenRouter cap $5

Measured: one visit check uses about 3,700 tokens in and 740 out, about $0.0013 on DeepSeek V3.2 and $0.015 on Claude Sonnet 5.5 at 2026-11-25 prices
